brief:
A Palestinian-American describes seeking assistance from the U.S. government after her husband was confronted by soldiers, according to Zeteo. The family says officials provided no aid and instead instructed them to address the matter directly with the military personnel involved.

When the husband attempted to confront the soldiers, he was pushed, threatened with arrest, and tear gassed. The family received no response from American authorities during the incident.
dek: The U.S. government has done nothing to help. They told us to confront the soldiers ourselves, and when my husband did, he was pushed, threatened with arrest, and tear gassed.
title: Palestinian-American says U.S. government ignored family's pleas for help
